apps.name: FitnessTrack
apps.subtitle: Dynamic double progression, adaptive tempo and deloads.
apps.localizedDescription:
A native SwiftUI port of FitnessTrack by Giuliano Maciocci: plans, fast set logging, per-set progression, adaptive tempo, deload suggestions, calendar, history charts and stats. Single-user and local-first: all data lives in one JSON file you can keep in iCloud Drive.

Source: https://github.com/Aphoh/fitness-track-ios
